segments.ja458:1.1: Ekā nisinnā suci saññatūrū, pāsādamāruyha aninditaṅgī;
segments.ja458:1.3: Yācāmi taṃ kinnaranettacakkhu, imekarattiṃ ubhayo vasema.
segments.ja458:3.1: Daharassa yuvino cāpi, āgamo ca na vijjati;
segments.ja458:3.3: Atha kena nu vaṇṇena, saṅgamaṃ icchase mayā.
segments.ja458:4.3: Tvaṃ maṃ nandaya [nandassu (syā. ka.)] bhaddante, puṇṇakaṃsaṃ dadāmi te.
segments.ja458:5.1: Devaṃ va yakkhaṃ atha vā manussaṃ, na patthaye udayamaticca aññaṃ;
segments.ja458:5.3: Gaccheva tvaṃ yakkha mahānubhāva, mā cassu gantvā punarāvajittha.
segments.ja458:6.1: Yā sā rati uttamā kāmabhoginaṃ, yaṃ hetu sattā visamaṃ caranti;
segments.ja458:6.3: Mā taṃ ratiṃ jīyi tuvaṃ sucimhi te, dadāmi te rūpiyaṃ kaṃsapūraṃ.
segments.ja458:7.1: Nāriṃ naro nijjhapayaṃ dhanena, ukkaṃsatī yattha karoti chandaṃ;
segments.ja458:7.3: Vipaccanīko tava devadhammo, paccakkhato thokatarena esi.
segments.ja458:8.1: Āyu ca vaṇṇo ca [āyuṃ ca vaṇṇaṃ ca (ka. sī. pī.)] manussaloke, nihīyati manujānaṃ suggatte;
segments.ja458:8.3: Teneva vaṇṇena dhanampi tuyhaṃ, nihīyati jiṇṇatarāsi ajja.
segments.ja458:9.3: Hāyateva tava [hāyate vata te (sī. syā. ka.), hāyateva tato (pī.)] vaṇṇo, ahorattānamaccaye.
segments.ja458:11.1: Devā na jīranti yathā manussā, gattesu tesaṃ valiyo na honti;
segments.ja458:11.3: Pucchāmi taṃ yakkha mahānubhāva, kathaṃ nu devāna [kathaṃ na devānaṃ (pī.)] sarīradeho.
segments.ja458:12.1: Devā na jīranti yathā manussā, gattesu tesaṃ valiyo na honti;
segments.ja458:12.3: Suve suve bhiyyatarova [bhiyyataro ca (ka.)] tesaṃ, dibbo ca vaṇṇo vipulā ca bhogā.
segments.ja458:13.1: Kiṃsūdha bhītā janatā anekā, maggo ca nekāyatanaṃ pavutto;
segments.ja458:13.3: Pucchāmi taṃ yakkha mahānubhāva, katthaṭṭhito paralokaṃ na bhāye.
segments.ja458:14.1: Vācaṃ manañca paṇidhāya sammā, kāyena pāpāni akubbamāno;
segments.ja458:14.3: Bahunnapānaṃ gharamāvasanto, saddho mudū saṃvibhāgī vadaññū;
segments.ja458:14.5: Saṅgāhako sakhilo saṇhavāco, etthaṭṭhito paralokaṃ na bhāye.
segments.ja458:15.1: Anusāsasi maṃ yakkha, yathā mātā yathā pitā;
segments.ja458:15.3: Uḷāravaṇṇaṃ pucchāmi, ko nu tvamasi subrahā.
segments.ja458:16.1: Udayohamasmi kalyāṇi, saṅkarattā idhāgato [saṅgaratthā idhāgato (sī. pī.), saṅgaratthāyidhāgato (syā.)];
segments.ja458:16.3: Āmanta kho taṃ gacchāmi, muttosmi tava saṅkarā [saṅgarā (sī. syā. pī.)].
segments.ja458:17.1: Sace kho tvaṃ udayosi, saṅkarattā idhāgato;
segments.ja458:17.3: Anusāsa maṃ rājaputta, yathāssa puna saṅgamo.
segments.ja458:18.1: Atipatati [adhipatatī (sī. pī.)] vayo khaṇo tatheva, ṭhānaṃ natthi dhuvaṃ cavanti sattā;
segments.ja458:18.3: Parijiyyati addhuvaṃ sarīraṃ, udaye mā pamāda [mā pamādaṃ (sī.)] carassu dhammaṃ.
segments.ja458:19.1: Kasiṇā pathavī dhanassa pūrā, ekasseva siyā anaññadheyyā;
segments.ja458:19.3: Tañcāpi jahati [jahāti (sī. syā. pī.), jahātī (?)] avītarāgo, udaye mā pamāda carassu dhammaṃ.
segments.ja458:20.1: Mātā ca pitā ca bhātaro ca, bhariyā yāpi dhanena hoti kītā [bhariyāpi dhanena honti atittā (ka.)];
segments.ja458:20.3: Te cāpi jahanti aññamaññaṃ, udaye mā pamāda carassu dhammaṃ.
segments.ja458:21.1: Kāyo parabhojananti ñatvā [kāyo ca parabhojanaṃ viditvā (ka.)], saṃsāre sugatiñca duggatiñca [sugatī ca duggatī ca (sī. syā. pī.), suggatiṃ duggatiñca (ka.)];
segments.ja458:21.3: Ittaravāsoti jāniyāna, udaye mā pamāda carassu dhammaṃ.
segments.ja458:22.1: Sādhu bhāsatiyaṃ [bhāsatayaṃ (sī. pī.)] yakkho, appaṃ maccāna jīvitaṃ;
segments.ja458:22.5: Sāhaṃ ekā pabbajissāmi, hitvā kāsiṃ surundhananti.
